questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Assign c_i=argmin_j ||x_i−μ_j||². Update μ_j=Mean of Assigned x_i. WCSS=Σ_i||x_i−μ_(c_i)||². Lloyd Iteration Objective Non-Increasing కానీ Global Optimum Guarantee కాదు.

questions.figure:
05 · CHOOSING K

Look for a bend in WCSS and check how separated groups are

Show optional Scikit-learn K-selection example
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.datasets import make_blobs
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

X, _ = make_blobs(n_samples=180, centers=3, cluster_std=0.8, random_state=8)
X = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)
for k in range(2, 6):
    model = KMeans(n_clusters=k, init="k-means++", n_init=10, random_state=42)
    labels = model.fit_predict(X)
    print(k, round(model.inertia_, 1), round(silhouette_score(X, labels), 2))
# Example results: 2 → 43.8, 0.81; 3 → 5.6, 0.84; 4 → 4.7, 0.67; 5 → 3.9, 0.53

The numbers come from one synthetic three-group dataset. Real datasets may not have a clear elbow or best score.
